chunks: And Amīr al-Muʾminīn, peace be upon him, used to say:
"If that is his weapon with which he shoots, then there is no harm."

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.سِلَاحَهُ: his weapon; the instrument used for shooting or hunting
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: then there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.يَرْمِي: he shoots or casts with it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to hunt with something that serves as a person’s weapon?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام regarding hunting. It indicates permissibility when the object in question is regarded as the hunter’s weapon used for shooting.
